llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a NATO Article 5 invocation maps to an escalation/risk-off regime: defense equities (ITA) higher and European equities (EZU) lower, with safe-haven and energy corroboration. The directional logic is sound but the base rate is tiny and prediction-market moves are noisy; 12h magnitudes typically fall short of the 700bps tradable bar unless accompanied by a concrete, fresh escalation headline. Treat as a monitor-and-confirm signal rather than a high-conviction trade.
key_assumptions: A meaningful, sharp upward move in the market's implied probability has occurred (not flat baseline)
The move reflects escalation risk rather than market mechanics or thin liquidity
ITA and EZU remain liquid and representative proxies for defense upside and European risk-off

The escalation is already public and priced, so no residual asset move follows the market signal
ETF proxies are weakly exposed over 12h — ITA/EZU dominated by macro (rates, broad equity beta) rather than the geopolitical tail
Direction reverses: a de-escalation or clarifying statement follows, and risk assets rally instead
